title: CGIL general strike and student protests lead to clashes with police in Bologna
seoTitle: Bologna general strike and student protests

tea.why: Protesters opposed the Meloni government's 2027 budget bill, rising living costs, re-armament policies, and current school conditions.
tea.want: The CGIL union and student groups demanded changes to the national budget, increased education funding, and an end to re-armament.
tea.changed: Nov 20: Police in riot gear used charges to push back protesters attempting to breach a security cordon near the Confindustria headquarters.

summary: On November 20, 2026, a general strike called by the CGIL union, combined with student demonstrations, resulted in confrontations between protesters and police in Bologna. The protest, which was part of a nationwide strike against the Meloni government's 2027 budget, focused on issues including the cost of living, military spending, and education. Near the Confindustria Emilia headquarters, a group of protesters carrying banners and smoke bombs attempted to break through a police security cordon. According to reports from ANSA and Il Fatto Quotidiano, officers in riot gear responded with multiple charges to push the demonstrators back toward Via Castiglione. While the strike also impacted local public transport and rail services throughout the day, the physical confrontation was concentrated near the business association's offices.
response: Police in riot gear formed a security cordon and conducted multiple charges to prevent protesters from reaching the Confindustria Emilia headquarters.

updates.text: Clashes occurred between police and protesters near the Confindustria Emilia headquarters during a general strike.
